neighbours.label: ' mist' as a metaphor for how brief life is (life is a mist that vanishes)
fire: Our years on earth are but a mist that fades by noon.
Life is only a mist that vanishes in the morning.
Fame is a mist that disappears with the first wind.
Youth is a passing mist that soon lifts from the hills.
All our plans are a mist that melts in the sun.
Wealth is a mist that is gone before you know it.
His whole career was a mist that passed quickly.
We are a mist that appears and then is gone.
quiet: Our years on earth are long and full of work by noon.
Life is only a game that begins in the morning.
Fame is a prize that comes with the first hit.
Youth is a happy time that many recall in the hills.
All our plans are written on a chart in the sun.
Wealth is a tool that is used before you know it.
His whole career was a job that paid well.
We are a family that eats and then goes home.
